title: Triage orchestrator manifest
description: Per-project opt-in manifest, lives at <project-root>/.claude/orchestrator.json. A flat role -> agent map; enablement only. A role that is null or omitted disables the phase that depends on it. The orchestrator reads this file with the Read tool — plugins cannot enforce a nested config schema, so this schema is documentation, not runtime validation.

pm.description: Name of the PM agent for ticket/epic tracking (e.g. "github-pm"). The agent must implement the PM contract. Backend config (repo, project id, etc.) stays in .claude/pm.json — this value only NAMES the agent. null/omitted disables all PM phases.

vault.description: Name of the vault agent for the project knowledge vault (e.g. "vault-manager"). null/omitted disables vault search, the vault-worthy-findings scan, and ambient-recall enrichment phases.

reviewers.description: Presence-only list of review agents to run after implementation. LIST ORDER IS IGNORED — the orchestrator owns review ordering. An empty list or omitted disables all review passes. Listing an agent here enables that review.

security.description: Name of the security review agent (e.g. "security-auditor"). Runs only when the change touches sensitive surface area (auth, secrets, persistence, migrations, external APIs, deserialisation, file I/O, shell). null/omitted disables the security pass entirely.

declined.description: Set to true to record that the user declined orchestration machinery for this project. The orchestrator treats a manifest with no enabled roles (or declined:true) as a settled decline and will NOT re-prompt. Re-run /orchestrator:init to re-enable.
